events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding stages worldwide! Happy birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV turns 45
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched 45 years ago today, famously kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: MTV Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember a time when music videos were appointment viewing? Forty-five years ago, MTV changed the game forever. What was the first video that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' 32 years ago, on August 29, 1994, solidifying their place in Britpop history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years of pure Britpop swagger! Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and a new era began. Which track from the album still gets you every time?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place 57 years ago this week in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and three days of music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on! What's your favourite performance from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the undisputed King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, 56 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the tragic passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true guitar visionary. Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, whose influence still resonates through music today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and unmistakable style have fronted The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a rock 'n' roll icon, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK 51 years ago, in 1975, to promote the 'Shaved Fish' compilation.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's timeless message of peace, 'Imagine', was released as a single. Its power endures. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple revolutionised portable music 25 years ago today with the release of the very first iPod in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire peace and love around the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago, on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. What are your hidden gems from this incredible double LP?
